point_format: little-endian signed int16 [x,y,compensated_radial_velocity,rcs], each Q8.8; 1..511 points; 21 signed INT8 features; INT32 logits
history: Same sequence/sensor/GT track, up to six preceding retained >=3-point observations plus current; sparse observations do not update history
history_scope: GT track association is upstream and remains a deployment limitation; accumulated coordinates are not a single-frame physical shape
output: 0 = original labels7/8, 1 = original0/1/2/3; logits argmax tie chooses0; no runtime normalization
